title.zh: 傅里叶变换 · 一步一交互
title.en: The Fourier Transform · One Interaction at a Time

desc.zh: 任何波形、任何图形，都能拆成一堆旋转的圆。从一条正弦波开始，七步亲手拼出傅里叶变换，最后画任意图形让圆圈重画出来。
desc.en: Any waveform — any picture — can be taken apart into rotating circles. Start from a single sine wave, build the Fourier transform with your own hands in seven steps, then draw any shape and watch the circles redraw it.
